# Bunifu UI for Windows Forms

Build C# and VB.NET Windows Forms applications with Bunifu UI controls.

## Install

In Visual Studio, open **Manage NuGet Packages**, search for
**Bunifu.UI.WinForms**, and install it.

Build your project, open a form in the designer, and add Bunifu controls from the Toolbox.

## Requirements

- A Windows Forms project targeting .NET Framework 4.6.2, 4.7.2, 4.8, or .NET 5–10 for Windows.
- A valid Bunifu license and activation. Licensing dependencies are restored automatically.

## Compatibility

**Strong-name signing:** If your .NET Framework project requires signed dependencies, please contact Bunifu support to discuss compatibility.

[Installation, activation and documentation](https://docs2.bunifuframework.com/docs/getting-started/install)
